summary.en: The promise as the biggest type in the film: one or two lines at 225 px rise a quarter beat apart, a 28 px ink bar grows under them, a mono label rises under the bar; one emphasised word takes the accent.
summary.zh: 把承诺排成全片最大的字：一两行 225 px 文字相隔四分之一拍升起，下面长出一条 28 px 墨条，墨条下升起一行等宽标签；一个强调词用强调色。

fits: The climax of a claim-plus-steps film, right before the closing page.
notFor: Taglines longer than two short lines; a film whose claim was not made earlier (it restates, it does not introduce).

intent.en: Restate the promise at full size in a pause, so it is the one sentence the viewer keeps; the accent word is the person.
intent.zh: 在停顿里用最大的字重说承诺，让它成为观众记住的那一句；强调词就是人。

content.en: 1–2 lines (≤ 17 chars each, `*word*` for the accent) and a label (≤ 60 chars).
content.zh: 1–2 行（每行 ≤ 7 字，用 *词* 标强调）和一行标签（≤ 24 字）。

fits.zh: “主张 + 步骤”型片子的高潮，紧接在落版之前。

notFor.zh: 超过两行短句的标语；前面没有提出过主张的片子（它是重申，不是引出）。

pairs.note: its block carries into the bar

en: Emphasis is marked with `*…*` in the copy, not found by matching words, so it works in Chinese; mark one word only.
zh: 强调用文案里的 *…* 标出，不靠按词匹配，所以中文也能用；只标一个词。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
